lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct white vertical lines are visible across the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform in the midsection, approximately 40-50 pixels between lines, with increased frequency and narrower spacing towards the posterior rump.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A singular Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the third vertical line from the posterior, where the line splits before reaching the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first posterior line is a fragmented segment that does not reach the ventral line. The two most anterior lines on the shoulder mass are truncated, terminating approximately one-third of the way down the torso height.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of three high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch/thigh region. These are arranged in a triangular formation with the largest spot situated dorsally to the two smaller spots.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white chevron markings are present on the bridge of the nose and muzzle. A large, high-contrast white crescent patch is visible on the lower throat. Distinct white horizontal bands ('socks') are present on all four limbs, located above the fetlock.
